evidence.notes: At 50 Hz the first component step occurs at 20 ms, then every 40 ms: f31 becomes e20 then d10 at 60 ms; after 64 fields it is black. The runner advances an explicit bounded fake clock. Source analysis, not an Amiga execution capture.
